source: testPositionsDoc/bachata_position_reference.md (user, refined 2026-11-01). Attribute = Body Arrangement | Partner Order | Arm/Hand Connection.
note: Condensed vocabulary (user decision 2026-11-01): mirror-pair positions that differ only by hand/arm side are inactive children of a family id (see parent_id). Flip active flags to re-enable sides later; keep ids stable; retired ids stay in the file with active=false. 'doc_no' = row(s) in the source document.

positions.name: Close Sensual Position
positions.description: Partners face each other in a close embrace, typically with hip connection. Torsos touching or nearly touching.

positions.name: Open Position (Basic Position)
positions.description: Partners face each other with space between them, connected by one or both hands. Standard hold: leader's left hand holds the follower's right hand.
cues: leader left to follower right (not crossed)

positions.name: Cross-Hand Position
positions.description: Partners face each other holding BOTH hands with the arms crossed (leader's left to follower's left and right to right), one arm passing over the other.

positions.name: Handshake Hold
positions.description: Partners face each other with a single handshake-style hand connection (same-side hands joined). Other hands free.

positions.name: Shadow Position – Follower in Front
positions.attribute: Shadow (Same Direction) | Follower in Front | Open / Frame Contact
positions.description: Follower stands ahead, leader stands directly behind, both facing the same direction. Hands held in an open frame or light frame contact, not wrapped across the body.

positions.name: Reverse Shadow Position – Leader in Front
positions.attribute: Shadow (Same Direction) | Leader in Front | Open / Body Contact
positions.description: Leader stands ahead, follower stands directly behind, both facing the same direction.

positions.name: Cuddle Position / Wrap Position – Follower in Front
positions.description: Follower is in front and wrapped by the leader, with one or both arms positioned across the follower's body.

positions.name: Side-by-Side
positions.description: Partners stand alongside each other, shoulder to shoulder, both facing the same direction, connected by one or both hands. Not wrapped.

positions.name: Back-to-Back Position
positions.description: Partners stand with their backs towards each other, facing opposite directions, often keeping a hand connection.

positions.name: Hammerlock
positions.description: One dancer's arm is folded behind their own back and held there by the partner's hand.

positions.name: Cross-Hand Position L/R
positions.description: Partners face each other holding both hands in a crossed configuration, with the leader's LEFT arm passing over the right. Leader's left holds follower's left, leader's right holds follower's right.

positions.name: Cross-Hand Position R/L
positions.description: Partners face each other holding both hands in a crossed configuration, with the leader's RIGHT arm passing over the left. Leader's right holds follower's right, leader's left holds follower's left.

positions.name: Handshake Hold LL
positions.description: Partners face each other with a single handshake-style hand connection: leader's LEFT hand holds the follower's LEFT hand. Other hands free.

positions.name: Handshake Hold RR
positions.description: Partners face each other with a single handshake-style hand connection: leader's RIGHT hand holds the follower's RIGHT hand. Other hands free.

positions.name: Side-by-Side – Leader on Left
positions.description: Partners stand alongside each other facing the same direction, with the leader on the follower's LEFT (from the dancers' own perspective). Open hand connection.

positions.name: Side-by-Side – Leader on Right
positions.description: Partners stand alongside each other facing the same direction, with the leader on the follower's RIGHT (follower is to the leader's left). Open hand connection.

positions.name: Hammerlock – Leader Left Arm
positions.description: The leader's LEFT arm is folded behind the leader's own back, held there by the follower's hand.
cues: it is the leader's left arm

positions.name: Hammerlock – Leader Right Arm
positions.description: The leader's RIGHT arm is folded behind the leader's own back, held there by the follower's hand.
cues: it is the leader's right arm

positions.name: Hammerlock – Follower Left Arm
positions.description: The follower's LEFT arm is folded behind the follower's own back, held there by the leader's hand.
cues: it is the follower's left arm

positions.name: Hammerlock – Follower Right Arm
positions.description: The follower's RIGHT arm is folded behind the follower's own back, held there by the leader's hand.
cues: it is the follower's right arm
